name: Shroud of Charged Filings
body:
School conjuration (creation) [electricity]; Level alchemist 1, bloodrager 1, druid/shaman 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1
Components V, S, M (a vial of powdered copper)

This spell functions as shroud of icy mist except you create a swirling cloud of charged copper around the target and the spell deals electricity damage instead of cold damage.
